hardBlockers.description: FAIL when harness validation shows that the stage did not leave the required durable artifact or valid repository state.
FAIL when implementation would still require the builder to make a material product or design decision.
FAIL when a load-bearing file, symbol, command, API, or precedent is nonexistent or asserted without verification.
FAIL when any acceptance criterion lacks an implementation task and named verification.
FAIL when the plan changes approved scope without an explicit decision.

requirements.description: Provide a dependency-ordered task sequence that a fresh builder can execute without hidden steps.
Name the files, symbols, boundaries, and behavior each task creates or changes.
Map every acceptance criterion to implementation work and objective verification.
Specify tests that fail before each behavior exists and identify the authoritative commands that verify the result.
Cover migrations, compatibility, failure handling, and operational wiring where the feature requires them.
Define coherent commit boundaries and final checks, including how unfinished or failed work remains visible.

dimensions.description: How completely a fresh builder can execute the plan without rediscovery or design work.
dimensions.good: B requires concrete ordered steps with enough context to implement and verify each one.
dimensions.excellent: A requires an economical plan whose tasks are independently verifiable and leave no consequential ambiguity.

dimensions.description: How clearly requirements, design decisions, implementation tasks, and tests connect.
dimensions.good: B requires complete mapping with no orphan requirement or unexplained task.
dimensions.excellent: A requires concise bidirectional traceability that makes omissions and scope drift immediately visible.

dimensions.description: How accurately the plan uses the actual repository structure, conventions, and available APIs.
dimensions.good: B requires verified references and an approach compatible with established project patterns.
dimensions.excellent: A requires precise use of repository evidence to minimize change and explain justified deviations.
